title: Console: feature-flagged onboarding checklist + dashboard banner placements
author: Chloe Martin
description: Implements the v1 console onboarding checklist component and two banner placements behind a feature flag, per ENG-2843. The checklist is designed to reduce time-to-first-success by making the activation steps explicit (API key, first request, streaming, view latency/cost). Includes: (1) a checklist component with step state derived from analytics events + lightweight server aggregation, (2) contextual banners on the Console home and Project page, (3) guardrails to avoid showing to already-activated users, and (4) rollout notes + QA matrix. This PR intentionally keeps copy minimal and defers final wording to the copy deck + remote config (follow-up). Flag: console.onboarding_checklist_v1 (default OFF). Screenshots are attached below as links to the PR artifacts. Related: ENG-2842 (assignment plumbing), ENG-2841 (event emission), PM-414 (scope).
body:
## Context
This is part of the Lifecycle Growth Experiments sprint (activation/retention). We need a feature-flagged onboarding UI that can be rolled out gradually, is cheap to render (no additional blocking calls on dashboard load), and can be safely hidden once a user hits activation.

## What’s included
- Onboarding checklist component (left-rail card on Console Home + responsive drawer on smaller widths)
- Two banner placements:
  1) Home banner: shown to non-activated users who have not created an API key
  2) Project banner: shown to users who created a key but have not yet completed a successful request
- Step state evaluation
  - Primary: derived from canonical events (api_key_created, first_request_success, first_streaming_success, dashboard_viewed)
  - Fallback: best-effort server-side aggregator endpoint (cached) for step completion when events are delayed
- Feature flag + kill switch
  - `console.onboarding_checklist_v1` gates all UI
  - `console.onboarding_banner_v1` allows banner-only rollout (for emergency rollback of checklist UI while keeping banners, if needed)
- Accessibility
  - Keyboard navigable step list
  - Uses semantic list markup and proper aria-labels for CTAs
  - Color contrast checks for banner variants

## Checklist steps (v1)
1. Create an API key (CTA links to /settings/api-keys)
2. Make your first request (CTA links to /quickstart?tab=curl)
3. Enable streaming (CTA links to /quickstart?tab=streaming)
4. View latency & cost (CTA links to /observability/latency-cost)

Step completion rules:
- API key: `api_key_created` OR `api_key_list_viewed` + key count > 0 (fallback)
- First request: `first_request_success` (2xx completion)
- Streaming: `first_streaming_success`
- Dashboard: `dashboard_viewed` with `dashboard_name=latency_cost`

## Performance considerations
- No additional blocking calls in the main dashboard bootstrap path.
- Checklist state is computed from locally cached event summaries (where available). If missing, we lazy-load `GET /api/console/onboarding/status` after first paint.
- The status endpoint is cached for 5 minutes per user and returns only booleans + timestamps.

## Rollout plan
1) Land behind flag OFF.
2) Enable for internal dogfood only (staff emails) for 24h.
3) Enable 5% of new signups (assignment handled by ENG-2842 middleware) with banner-only sub-flag ON.
4) Expand to 25% after guardrail checks (console p95 load, banner clicks, support-link clicks).
5) Iterate copy and step ordering in remote config (follow-up PR).

## Screenshots (PR artifacts)
- Home (non-activated): `artifacts/8938/home_checklist_non_activated.png`
- Home banner (no API key): `artifacts/8938/home_banner_create_key.png`
- Project banner (key created, no success): `artifacts/8938/project_banner_first_request.png`
- Mobile drawer: `artifacts/8938/mobile_checklist_drawer.png`

## Testing
- Unit tests for completion logic + step ordering
- Storybook snapshots for checklist + banner components
- E2E: basic smoke in Playwright for flag ON/OFF behavior

## Out of scope
- Final copy polish / localization strings (we’re using interim copy + TODOs wired for remote config)
- Experiment analytics dashboards (ENG-2845)

## Risks / mitigations
- Incorrectly showing to already activated users → guarded by `first_request_success` and `first_streaming_success` checks + “dismiss permanently” action.
- Event delay causing UI flapping → server status endpoint is cached and we debounce UI updates.
- Console perf regression → lazy load status endpoint; no extra blocking calls.
commits: console(onboarding): add checklist component and step renderer
console(onboarding): add home + project banner placements
console(flags): gate checklist + banners behind feature flags
e2e(console): smoke test for onboarding flags
review_conversation:
Kenji Nakamura (design): Can we reduce the visual weight of the checklist header and ensure the step CTAs don’t look like primary actions everywhere? Also, mobile behavior: the drawer should not auto-open.

Chloe Martin (author): Updated header typography to match existing card headers and made CTAs secondary buttons (except step 2 which remains primary). Drawer is now user-invoked via “Get started” button; no auto-open.

Marissa Cole (PM): We should avoid showing the checklist once someone has a successful request, even if they haven’t viewed the dashboard. Otherwise we’ll annoy users who already integrated.

Chloe Martin (author): Added `first_request_success` guard to hide the entire module by default once activated; users can still access “Next steps” via the help menu (future follow-up).

Jada Williams (eng): Please confirm this doesn’t block initial render. Also we need the flags wired to the assignment middleware in ENG-2842—right now you’re reading from local flag provider.

Chloe Martin (author): Status endpoint is fetched after first paint; added timing marks to verify. Flag provider remains the single interface; it will be backed by the assignment middleware once ENG-2842 lands (I added TODO + integration point).

Sean Gallagher (SLO/guardrails): Add a circuit breaker for the onboarding status endpoint. If it errors, the console should not spam retries.

Chloe Martin (author): Added 1 retry max + 15 minute backoff in the client; endpoint returns 204 on missing data.

Leila Farouk (QA): E2E needs explicit coverage for dismissal persistence and that banner doesn’t show when flag is off.

Chloe Martin (author): Added Playwright checks for (1) flag OFF = no module/banners, (2) dismiss hides checklist and persists across reload.

Final approvals:
- Kenji Nakamura: Approved
- Marissa Cole: Approved
- Jada Williams: Approved
- Sean Gallagher: Approved (after retry/backoff)
- Leila Farouk: Approved
release_notes: Console onboarding checklist + banners are now available behind feature flags `console.onboarding_checklist_v1` and `console.onboarding_banner_v1` for the activation experiments sprint.
